about_the_game:
Stand out from the other hunters in the world of Dragonkin and customize your town however you like with this new free DLC for Dragonkin: The Banished. Founder Pack 3 contains:

  • An exclusive "Springtime Alliance" complete pack including cosmetic items for your city: statues, roofs, flags, and pennants
  • 2 variations of a visual effect that plays upon your character's death
  • 6 exclusive pieces of equipment including a torso and a helmet for the Knight, the Oracle, and the Barbarian (2 per character)
  • 6 exclusive pieces of equipment including a torso and a helmet for the Tracker

This cosmetic pack will be available for download for a limited period, starting with the release of this second game update on August 26, 2025, and ending with the release of the third Early Access update in Fall 2025. After this date, these items will no longer be obtainable.
